name: Create a Namespace
description: Create a Namespace Creates a namespace under the given title. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces
Creates a namespace under the given title. A `400` is returned if the account already owns a namespace with this title. A namespace must be explicitly deleted to be replaced.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete key-value pair
description: Delete key-value pair Remove a KV pair from the namespace. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key_name}

name: Delete multiple key-value pairs
description: Delete multiple key-value pairs Remove multiple KV pairs from the namespace. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk/delete
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk/delete
Remove multiple KV pairs from the namespace. Body should be an array of up to 10,000 keys to be removed.
Required: namespace_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete multiple key-value pairs
description: Delete multiple key-value pairs Remove multiple KV pairs from the namespace. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk
Remove multiple KV pairs from the namespace. Body should be an array of up to 10,000 keys to be removed.
Required: namespace_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Get a Namespace
description: Get a Namespace Get the namespace corresponding to the given ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}

name: Get multiple key-value pairs
description: Get multiple key-value pairs Retrieve up to 100 KV pairs from the namespace. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk/get
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk/get
Retrieve up to 100 KV pairs from the namespace. Keys must contain text-based values. JSON values can optionally be parsed instead of being returned as a string value. Metadata can be included if `withMetadata` is true.
Required: namespace_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: List a Namespace's Keys
description: List a Namespace's Keys Lists a namespace's keys. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/keys
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/keys
Lists a namespace's keys.
Required: namespace_id (path); account_id (path)
Optional: limit (query); prefix (query); cursor (query)

name: List Namespaces
description: List Namespaces Returns the namespaces owned by an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces
Returns the namespaces owned by an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); order (query); direction (query)

name: Read key-value pair
description: Read key-value pair Returns the value associated with the given key in the given namespace. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key_name}

name: Read the metadata for a key
description: Read the metadata for a key Returns the metadata associated with the given key in the given namespace. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/metadata/{key_name}

name: Remove a Namespace
description: Remove a Namespace Deletes the namespace corresponding to the given ID. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}

name: Rename a Namespace
description: Rename a Namespace Modifies a namespace's title. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}

name: Write key-value pair with optional metadata
description: Write key-value pair with optional metadata Write a value identified by a key. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key_name}
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/values/{key_name}
Write a value identified by a key. Use URL-encoding to use special characters (for example, `:`, `!`, `%`) in the key name. Body should be the value to be stored. If JSON metadata to be associated with the key/value pair is needed, use `multipart/form-data` content type for your PUT request (see dropdown below in `REQUEST BODY SCHEMA`). Existing values, expirations, and metadata will be overwritten. If neither `expiration` nor `expiration_ttl` is specified, the key-value pair will never expire. If both are set, `expiration_ttl` is used and `expiration` is ignored.
Required: key_name (path); namespace_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: expiration (query); expiration_ttl (query)

name: Write multiple key-value pairs
description: Write multiple key-value pairs Write multiple keys and values at once. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/{namespace_id}/bulk
Write multiple keys and values at once. Body should be an array of up to 10,000 key-value pairs to be stored, along with optional expiration information. Existing values and expirations will be overwritten. If neither `expiration` nor `expiration_ttl` is specified, the key-value pair will never expire. If both are set, `expiration_ttl` is used and `expiration` is ignored. The entire request size must be 100 megabytes or less.
Required: namespace_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)
